failure.agent_error: The agent ran into an error and couldn't finish replying. Please try again.
failure.timeout: The agent took too long and stopped before finishing. Try again, or break your request into smaller steps.
failure.codex_semantic_inactivity: The agent went idle and stopped before finishing. Please try again.
failure.runtime_offline: The agent is offline right now, so it couldn't reply. Please try again once it's back online.
failure.runtime_access_denied: This agent's private runtime isn't accessible. Make the runtime public, or bind the agent to an accessible runtime.
failure.runtime_recovery: The agent restarted before it could finish. Please try again.
failure.runtime_access_revoked: Runtime access was revoked. Bind the agent to an accessible runtime before starting another run.
failure.skill_bundle_unavailable: The agent's skills couldn't be downloaded, so it never got started. This is usually a connection problem — please try again.
failure.runtime_cli_timeout: The local OpenClaw CLI timed out before answering. Check your local OpenClaw CLI setup or raise MULTICA_OPENCLAW_CLI_TIMEOUT before retrying.
failure.environment_prepare_failed: The machine running the agent couldn't set this run up, so it never started. The error below says what failed there — often disk space, a permission, a folder still in use, or a local config that couldn't be read. It isn't the agent or the model provider.
failure.provider_network: The connection to the model provider dropped before the reply finished. Check your network and try again.
failure.provider_auth_or_access: The provider rejected this agent's credentials or access. Check the API key or account — it may have expired or no longer have access.
failure.provider_quota_limit: The agent's model account has run out of credit. Top it up or switch accounts, then retry.
failure.provider_capacity_or_rate_limit: The model provider is busy or rate-limiting this account. Please try again in a moment.
failure.context_overflow: This chat got too long for the model. Start a new chat to continue.
failure.runtime_missing_executable: The agent's CLI couldn't be run on this machine. Check that it's installed correctly and on PATH, then retry.
failure.runtime_version_unsupported: The agent's CLI is too old for this runtime. Upgrade it, then retry.
failure.fallback: Something went wrong and the agent couldn't finish replying. Please try again.
failure.local_directory_missing: The local folder linked to this project no longer exists on the machine running the agent, so the run never started. Restore the folder, then try again. To use a different folder, open the project in the desktop app on that machine, remove the old folder from Resources, and add the new one with Add → Local folder... — a browser can't choose folders.
